searched.title: Bambu Support for PLA/PETG Safety Data Sheet SDS20250723S05

documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: Support for PLA/PETG
Bambu Support for PLA/PETG Safety Data Sheet SDS20250723S05
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: No hex: the store page links no hex-code document for this filament and none is cached, so its colour values "Nature (65102)" and "Black (65103)" have no published hex.

not_published: the TDS states "N/A" for glass transition, Vicat softening, heat deflection (1.8 and 0.45 MPa) and every mechanical row (Young's modulus, tensile strength, breaking elongation, bending modulus, bending strength, impact strength; X-Y and Z); the SDS section 9 says "No data available". Filament length and hardness are stated nowhere.

Composition conflict (material.type, unverified): TDS p.3 "Polylactic acid" versus SDS section 3 "Thermoplastic Polyurethane" 74.9-90 % + PETG 9.9-25 % + additive. Left to review; no composition is picked.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: melt index 14.3 ± 1.2 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature N/A, saturated water absorption rate 1.02 % (25 °C, 55% RH), spool material PC + ABS (temperature resistance 90 °C), spool size 200 × 67 mm, printing and storage humidity < 20% RH (sealed, with desiccant), bed surface preparation glue, retraction length 0.6 - 1.0 mm, retraction speed 20 - 40 mm/s, chamber temperature 25 - 45 °C (thermal.chamber_temp is the printer chamber key), max overhang angle 55°, max bridging length 30 mm, support "Turn on", odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products.
SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: model "S05-xx", CLP "Not classified", no hazard pictogram, "Not hazardous goods" for IMDG, DOT, ADR/RID and ICAO-TI/IATA transport, SVHC "Not listed".

Drying requirement differs between wiki pages (not a stored key): the support wiki 2.1 gives "Pre-print Drying: Required" and "Moisture Protection During Printing: Required"; the drying wiki Appendix I gives "Recommended" and "Not required but recommended"; the store page says "Recommended Drying before Use".

Store page copy to review: its Printing Tips › 4.Safety Tips carry a sub-bullet "As this filament contains highly hygroscopic wood fibers…", which neither the TDS nor the SDS composition supports (apparent template text from another filament).
Marketing prose is not used for numbers: "zero top interface spacing & Z distance" (feature block 2) is not stored.

Not cached, so not read: the store page's "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/85b0296f5ef74f0982819b0aabf0af7b.pdf; safety.certifications is left to review) and the wiki page https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/software/bambu-studio/support (slicer support settings) linked from the Printing Tips.
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.05 mm) comes from the store page only (Product Features › bullet 6) and is written by the page layer (verified, official_page); it is not repeated here.
